test_item:
Log Encryption should provide log file encryption APIs for native clients.
(the encryptLogFile API is provided for LogDog (document review))
pre: 1. Access to the RD build environment for Log Encryption is granted
proc:
1. <obtain the LogEncrypt library per RD>
2. Review the LogEncrypt library against "LogEncrypt library should provide API for LogDog: encryptLogFile(const std::string& plainLogFilename, const std::string& protectedLogFilename, const std::string& protectedKeyFilename) to encrypt log files"
er:
1. The LogEncrypt library is available for review
2. The LogEncrypt library satisfies "LogEncrypt library should provide API for LogDog: encryptLogFile(const std::string& plainLogFilename, const std::string& protectedLogFilename, const std::string& protectedKeyFilename) to encrypt log files"
